workflow_rationale: This is a feature development task extending an existing partial implementation. The annotation layer exists but needs completion of four annotation types (text, arrows, zones, free-hand), plus CRUD operations and persistence. Follows a typical feature workflow: foundation (types/validation) → rendering improvements → new capabilities → integration.

phases.name: Type System & Validation Foundation
phases.description: Create TypeScript type definitions using discriminated unions and validation utilities for annotation data integrity

subtasks.description: Create annotation type definitions with discriminated unions
subtasks.notes: Created src/types/annotations.ts with discriminated unions for TextAnnotation, ArrowAnnotation, ZoneAnnotation, and DrawingAnnotation. Includes type guards, factory types, update types, and serialization utilities. Committed as 36d9f24.

Created src/utils/annotationValidation.ts with comprehensive validation utilities:
- validateTextAnnotation: validates non-empty text and valid position
- validateArrowAnnotation: validates non-zero length (min 0.01 distance)
- validateZoneAnnotation: validates non-zero area for circle/rectangle shapes
- validateDrawingAnnotation: validates minimum 2 points for path
- validateBaseAnnotation: validates common properties (id, color, thickness, createdAt)
- validateAnnotation: generic validator using type guards
- Helper utilities: isValidAnnotation, filterValidAnnotations, getInvalidAnnotations, validateAnnotations
All validators return ValidationResult with valid flag and error array. Committed as 406117b.

phases.name: Enhanced Text & Arrow Rendering
phases.description: Improve text annotations to render actual text using @react-three/drei Text, and add arrowheads to arrow annotations

checks: Text annotation renders with actual text content
Text is visible and legible on field

subtasks.notes:
Created src/components/Annotations/TextAnnotation.tsx using @react-three/drei Text and Billboard components. Features:
- Uses Billboard wrapper for camera-facing readability from any angle
- Renders annotation.text content with configurable fontSize
- Positions text at annotation.points[0] coordinates
- Adds black outline (outlineWidth: 0.05) for visibility on field
- Places text 0.5 units above field surface to prevent z-fighting
- Validates annotation has required text and position before rendering
Committed as 842a701.

subtasks.description: Implement ArrowAnnotation component with arrowhead cone

checks: Arrow renders from start to end point
Arrowhead cone visible at end point

subtasks.notes:
Created src/components/Annotations/ArrowAnnotation.tsx component that:
- Renders line segment from startPoint (points[0]) to endPoint (points[1]) using bufferGeometry
- Adds cone mesh arrowhead at end point for clear direction indication
- Calculates cone rotation using spherical coordinates to align with arrow direction
- Positions cone so tip is exactly at endpoint
- Uses annotation.color for both line and cone
- Supports annotation.thickness for line width
- Validates minimum 2 points before rendering
Committed as 1bc4cc4.

subtasks.description: Update AnnotationLayer to use new Text and Arrow components
subtasks.notes:
Updated AnnotationLayer.tsx to use the new TextAnnotation and ArrowAnnotation components:
- Added imports for TextAnnotation and ArrowAnnotation from ../Annotations folder
- Updated AnnotationRenderer to handle text type with minimum 1 point requirement
- Separated 'line' and 'arrow' cases - arrow now uses ArrowAnnotation component with cone arrowhead
- Line case continues using LineAnnotation for free-hand drawing paths
- Removed redundant local TextAnnotation function (now using imported component)
Committed as 96401b1.

phases.name: Zone Highlighting & Free-hand Drawing
phases.description: Implement zone highlighting components and free-hand drawing capability for tactical annotations

subtasks.description: Implement ZoneAnnotation component for highlighting areas
subtasks.notes:
Created src/components/Annotations/ZoneAnnotation.tsx that renders semi-transparent zone shapes for highlighting areas of the field. Features:
- Supports both 'circle' and 'rectangle' annotation types via routing to CircleZone/RectangleZone sub-components
- CircleZone: uses circleGeometry with radius calculated from distance between points[0] (center) and points[1] (edge)
- RectangleZone: uses planeGeometry with width/height calculated from two corner points
- Semi-transparent fill (opacity=0.3, transparent=true) allows field visibility underneath
- Positioned at y=0.02 above field to prevent z-fighting
- Rotated to lie flat on X-Z plane
- Uses useMemo for efficient recalculation of radius and dimensions
- Validates minimum 2 points before rendering
Committed as 2692a86.

subtasks.description: Implement DrawingAnnotation component for free-hand paths
subtasks.notes:
Created src/components/Annotations/DrawingAnnotation.tsx that renders free-hand drawing paths using bufferGeometry with bufferAttribute. Features:
- Uses useMemo to memoize flattened points array into Float32Array for efficient buffer rendering
- Validates minimum 2 points before rendering (returns null otherwise)
- Renders line element with bufferGeometry containing all captured path points
- Uses lineBasicMaterial with configurable color and linewidth (thickness) from annotation
- Follows patterns from Field.tsx and other annotation components (ArrowAnnotation, ZoneAnnotation)
Committed as d431042.

subtasks.description: Add free-hand drawing interaction to useAnnotationInteraction

checks: Dragging with 'line' tool captures continuous path

subtasks.notes:
Added free-hand drawing interaction to useAnnotationInteraction hook:
- Modified handlePointerMove to capture continuous path for 'line' tool (free-hand drawing)
- Points are added to currentPointsRef.current array during drag (not just start/end)
- Added minimum distance threshold (0.5 units) between points to optimize performance and avoid excessive points
- Arrow, circle, and rectangle tools maintain two-point behavior (start and end/edge points only)
- Drawing completes on pointer up with all captured intermediate points
Committed as 1c97a82.

subtasks.description: Update AnnotationLayer to render zones and drawings

checks: All annotation types coexist without errors

subtasks.notes:
Updated AnnotationLayer.tsx to render zones and drawings using dedicated components:
- Imported ZoneAnnotation and DrawingAnnotation from ../Annotations folder
- Updated switch case: 'line' now uses DrawingAnnotation (renders continuous path via bufferGeometry)
- Updated switch case: 'circle' and 'rectangle' now share ZoneAnnotation (renders semi-transparent filled shapes)
- Removed inline LineAnnotation, CircleAnnotation, RectangleAnnotation functions (replaced by imported components)
- All annotation types now use proper dedicated components with improved rendering:
  - text → TextAnnotation (Billboard + drei Text)
  - arrow → ArrowAnnotation (line + cone arrowhead)
  - circle/rectangle → ZoneAnnotation (circleGeometry/planeGeometry with opacity=0.3)
  - line → DrawingAnnotation (bufferGeometry with memoized Float32Array)
Committed as 9afb7a6.

phases.name: Selection & Editing Capabilities
phases.description: Implement annotation selection via clicking and editing capabilities with draggable handles

subtasks.notes: Added selectedAnnotationId state, selectAnnotation action, and getAnnotation helper to annotationStore. Also updated removeAnnotation and clearAnnotations to handle selection cleanup.

subtasks.description: Create useAnnotationSelection hook for raycasting selection
subtasks.notes:
Created useAnnotationSelection hook for raycasting-based annotation selection. Features:
- Proximity-based selection using distance calculations for each annotation type
- Text: distance to position point
- Arrow/Line: minimum distance to line segments (using perpendicular distance calculation)
- Circle: returns 0 if inside, otherwise distance to edge
- Rectangle: returns 0 if inside, otherwise distance to nearest edge
- Selection threshold of 5.0 world units
- Toggle selection by clicking same annotation
- Deselect by clicking empty space
- Only active when no drawing tool is selected
- Follows patterns from useAnnotationInteraction.ts
Committed as 4d62b57.

subtasks.description: Add selection highlighting to annotation components

checks: Only one annotation selected at a time

subtasks.notes: Added selection highlighting to all four annotation components (TextAnnotation, ArrowAnnotation, ZoneAnnotation, DrawingAnnotation). Each component now uses useAnnotationStore to check selectedAnnotationId, supports click-to-select with stopPropagation, has hover state for visual feedback, and displays selection indicator rings when selected. Follows Player.tsx pattern for consistent selection behavior.

subtasks.description: Implement draggable handles for annotation editing

checks: Selected text annotation can be dragged to new position
Selected arrow endpoints can be dragged
Selected zone boundaries can be resized

subtasks.notes: Implemented draggable handles for all annotation types. TextAnnotation supports full drag, ArrowAnnotation has endpoint handles, ZoneAnnotation (circle/rectangle) has boundary handles for resizing. Uses useFrame with raycasting pattern from Player.tsx. Added updateAnnotationPoints and updateAnnotationPoint actions to annotationStore.

steps: Reload and verify player positions preserved
Verify camera position and zoom preserved

subtasks.notes: Ensure backward compatibility with playbooks that don't have annotations field. Handle undefined annotations gracefully.
